title: Roll out the learned gridworld policy
description: You follow greedy action choices and plot the sampled trajectory.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You choose the largest Q entry for a known state and action zero otherwise. rollout resets the environment and stores the starting state.

steps.question: Does this rollout update Q after receiving rewards?
steps.answer: It reads Q to choose actions and accumulates rewards, but contains no Q update. Terminal checks or the step limit end the rollout.

steps.description: You append each next state and add its reward to ret. The recorded rollout from the supplied start returns 0.92.
You draw walls and terminal cells, then plot the stored trajectory. Columns become horizontal coordinates and rows become vertical coordinates.
